newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-COOPER SAVES FOREST IN FINAL SECONDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COOPER SAVES FOREST IN FINAL SECONDS.

text.p: Colin Cooper salvaged a precious point for Nottingham Forest with a last-gasp equaliser against fellow premier league strugglers Blackburn on Monday.
Blackburn appeared to have plunged Forest deeper into trouble at the foot of the table with a second-half fightback that appeared to have earned them a hard-earned win.
But well into injury time Cooper bundled the ball home from close range at the second attempt after Kevin Campbell had mis-kicked from Chris Allen's cross.
Stuart Pearce fired Forest ahead with a penalty in first half injury time but Blackburn turned the game on its head with two goals in three minutes after the break.

Kevin Gallacher snatched a 53rd minute equaliser, stabbing Graeme Le Saux's cross past Mark Crossley, and within three minutes Jason Wilcox pounced to put Rovers ahead when Crossley could only parry Gallacher's drive.
